title: 吉路尔chaser pro 外胎
notes: Owner post (2025-04-30): Chaser Pro 120 TPI, 219 g, CNY 130 per tire with a free butyl tube; the owner planned a long-term test. Commenters: light but thin, punctured by a small stone; cut by glass; one found several large cracks after a month of weekend riding (several hundred kilometres), while another rode it for almost half a year, including the Duku Highway, without problems.
